title: Resolution urging FIFA to pay New York City $1 million World Cup contribution
summary: This resolution calls on FIFA to pay New York City the $1 million “legacy contribution” it promised host cities of the 2026 World Cup. The Council notes the City spent an estimated $90 million preparing for the tournament while collecting only about $51 million in related tax revenue. A report from The Athletic in August 2026 found FIFA had not yet made the promised payments to host cities.
